leftovers: Brenton supplies 'God' to complete 'I am not your God'; the Greek ends at ὑμῶν.
'shall know him' ends Brenton's 6:2 and renders γνωσόμεθα, the first words of the Greek 6:3, which no chunk of this verse can hold.
'despised me' renders κατεφρόνησέν μου, the end of the Greek 6:7, which Brenton's English puts in his 6:8.
'in the house of Israel' renders ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ τοῦ Ἰσραήλ, the start of the Greek 6:10, which Brenton's English puts at the end of his 6:9.
